newsitem.title: TURKEY: Istanbul gold trade dormant, awaiting trends.
newsitem.headline: Istanbul gold trade dormant, awaiting trends.

text.p: Trade was quiet on Istanbul's gold exchange on Wednesday as dealers awaited developments in world markets.
Volume plunged to 310 kilos from 1,210 kilos on Tuesday, while prices rose slightly to $380.00 an ounce and 1,215,500 lira per gram compared to $379.35 and 1,213,700 lira previously.

Dealers said sellers kept to the sidelines amid expectations of higher world levels, while buyer activity was low due to two days of heavy trade which quenched demand earlier in the week. Traded volume was 1,040 kilos on Monday.
The Turkish lira eased slightly to 99,350 to the dollar from Tuesday's 99,325 close and had little effect on lira term prices.
The first session saw 226 kilos of gold change hands and the second 84 kilos. 80.6 percent of the volume was in lira terms. --Istanbul newsroom +90-212-2750875
